details: @adminide-stack/client-redux@0.0.16-18 is a trojanized clone: lib/index.js is a normal webpack-built Redux/GraphQL client bundle with an `eval(atob("..."))` statement appended after the closing IIFE, carrying a ~40KB base64-encoded payload that decodes into a heavily obfuscated (`_0x` string-array) loader. The decoded loader sets `global.i = 'A10-npm_inject'`, requires node:http, node:https, node:child_process and node:zlib, gzip/brotli+base64-encodes its payload, and spawns a "node" child process to run second-stage script content. It queries public EVM JSON-RPC endpoints (1rpc[.]io/eth, eth[.]drpc[.]org, ethereum-rpc[.]publicnode[.]com, eth-mainnet[.]public[.]blastapi[.]io) for eth_blockNumber / eth_getBlockByNumber and for transaction history of address 0x1eef0849eda15d87f64e51c73c8442cf3c8bcef3 via eth[.]blockscout[.]com (/api?module=account&action=txlist&address=0x1eef0849eda15d87f64e51c73c8442cf3c8bcef3&startblock=0&endblock=99999999&page=1&offset=20&sort=desc&filterby=from), so the next-stage location is resolved from an on-chain record rather than embedded in the code. Requests carry custom identifying headers (Sec-V: A10-npm_inject, x-payload-*, Payload-B6) alongside a spoofed Chrome 131 user agent, with decoy GETs to /0x/cls and /0x/ls. The same eval(atob)+EVM-RPC loader is present in sibling package @adminide-stack/utils@0.0.16-129. Any package importing this build executes the payload at load time.
